news_items.title: Digital User Group
news_items.description: Anyone in Hull who is interested in improving digital services can become a member of our Digital User Group. As a member, you’ll have the opportunity to test new and existing online services and share your experiences. it’s a simple way to make a real difference and improve our digital services.

news_items.title: Cost of living support
news_items.description: If you're finding it difficult to manage everyday expenses, help and support may be available. Our cost of living support pages provide information on financial assistance, benefits, energy, household cost support, food aid, debt advice, and local services that can help you access the support you need.

news_items.title: Crisis and Resilience Fund Grants for Organisations
news_items.description: The Crisis and Resilience Fund Grants are now open to applications. This is an opportunity for local organisations and public services to work together to make a lasting difference.

news_items.title: New rewards app launched for Hull
news_items.description: A new rewards app has officially launched in Hull turning everyday walks, cycle rides, and public transport trips into high-street shopping vouchers and charitable donations.
